name: forgeai-showcase
description: ForgeAI — AI website builder. Describe a business in one sentence; get a real, published multi-page website. Demo video, screenshots and live app.

paragraphs: Describe a business in one sentence. ForgeAI asks a few smart questions, researches the business on the web, designs a unique look, writes every page, and publishes a real multi-page website — in about two minutes.
About this repository. This is the public showcase of ForgeAI. The product's source code is kept in a private repository. Here you can see what ForgeAI does, how it is built, and try it live.
Sadaqat Rasool — Full-stack developer (MERN · Next.js · TypeScript) and founder of ForgeAI.
features: AI questions before building — 3–5 multiple-choice questions with free-text answers; can be skipped.
Web research — looks up the real business or person and uses only what it finds, with sources.
If nothing is found it says so; it never invents facts.
Up to 12 pages per site, each written separately and in parallel, so every page gets full, specific content.
Images for every visual section — AI-generated, or real stock photos and videos from Pexels / Unsplash.

whatItDoes.text: Describe a business in one sentence. ForgeAI asks a few smart questions, researches the business on the web, designs a unique look, writes every page, and publishes a real multi-page website — in about two minutes.
